## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its local-data or source-access impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Migrations are append-only and documented, if applicable
- [ ] Responsive and keyboard behavior checked for UI changes
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, cookies, tokens, personal notes, runtime databases, backups, profile exports, or browser profiles
- [ ] No raw source HTML or full private descriptions
- [ ] No live source request in automated tests
- [ ] No collection scheduler, login automation, CAPTCHA bypass, stealth, or proxy rotation
- [ ] No generated build, coverage, test-report, PID, or archive artifact
